name: Sakura

skills.name: Sakura Chime
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Falling Blossom
skills.description: Selects an empty tile within a 2-tile radius of a friendly Doll or an enemy affected by Sakura Mark, then jumps to that tile, dealing AoE Burn damage equal to 60% ATK to all enemies within a 2-tile radius. Grants Extra Command.

skills.name: Misfortune Delivery
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Burn damage equivalent to 130% ATK to it, and applies 2 stacks of Sakura Mark.
Before attacking, additionally applies Bad Luck to the target for 3 turns.

skills.name: Grand Isekai Adventure
skills.description:
Selects one direction and applies 3 stacks of Sakura Mark to all enemies within a 3×10 tile area in front, dealing AoE Burn damage equal to 90% ATK.
After using this skill, triggers the effect of Sakura Mark, and gains Good Luck for 2 turns and 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Ferlicitous Prayer
skills.description: At the start of battle, gains Thermal Conduction. When triggering the effect of Sakura Mark and if the ultimate skill Grand Isekai Adventure has not been used, gains 2 stacks of Searing Flame. At the start of each turn, gains 2 points of Confectance Index and applies 2 stacks of Sakura Mark to 3 random enemies on the field. If Sakura has Good Luck, her damage is increased by 20%.

fortification.effect:
Randomly applies Sakura Mark to up to 5 enemies; the damage multiplier of Sakura Mark increases to 90%, and its effective radius increases by 1 tile.
If an enemy unit is standing on a Burn-type tile, damage dealt by Sakura Mark is increased by 30%.
Increases range by 1 tile; increases effective area by 1 tile; increases damage multiplier by 15%; reduces Confectance Index consumption by 1 point.

If the user has Good Luck, increases damage dealt by 50% and Critical Damage by 25%.
When an enemy gains Sakura Mark, creates Incineration tiles within a 1-tile radius around it for 3 turns; when Sakura Mark deals damage, it ignores 15% of the target’s DEF
Increases the number of Sakura Mark stacks applied to 3; increases the damage bonus from Bad Luck to 30%.
Increases the damage multiplier by 30%; expands the effective area to a 5×10 tile zone in front; stack this effect to the limit on all enemy units across the entire field affected by Sakura Mark.

Good Luck gains an additional effect:
Before a friendly unit performs an active attack or an out-of-turn attack (excluding the user), Sakura applies 1 stack of Sakura Mark to that target.
Can trigger up to 3 times per turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Hard Work and Guts
keys.effect: At the start of battle, applies 1 stack of Sakura Mark to any 3 enemy units on the field.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Just In Time Logistic
keys.effect: When applying Sakura Mark with a non-Ultimate skill, also applies Overburn for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Apologize From The Heart
keys.effect: When applying Bad Luck, dispels 1 buff from the target.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Jinxed by Nature
keys.effect: At the start of battle, applies Bad Luck to the enemy unit with the highest HP on the field for 3 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Flying Solo
keys.effect: At the end of the action, if there are enemy units within a 3-tile radius, gains 1 stack of Quick Barrier.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Improving Everyday
keys.effect: When an enemy affected by Sakura Mark dies, increases self ATK by 4%, up to a maximum of 20%.

keys.name: Common Key - Ace Courier
keys.effect: CRIT +5.0% / Increases AOE damage dealt to enemy targets with debuffs by 10%.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Dance of the Fire Sakura
keys.effect:
When acquiting Extra Command by using the active skill Omnidirectional Shift, can move 6 tiles.
The damage miltiplier of Sakura Mark is increased by 15%. For every 3 times of effect Sakura Mark is triggered (excluding triggers by the Ultimate Skill Domain of Bad Luck), gains 1 Confectance Index, up to a maximum of 4 per turn.
Each time the effect of Thermal Conduction is triggered, damage dealt by self permanently increases by 15% and Critical Damage permanently increases by 15% up to a maximum increase of 75%.
